title: Correct refractive index
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for part (1) must be n = 4/3 (or equivalent decimal).

title: Correct propagation time
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for part (2) must be t = 5R/(3c) (or equivalent simplified form).

title: Applies Snell's Law correctly
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply Snell's law at point F to relate the incident angle (53°) to the refracted angle α.

title: Determines angle α geometrically
description: Important Criteria: The solution must use the right triangle OEF to find tan α = OF/OE = 3/4, leading to α = 37°.

title: Analyzes path for ray 2
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly trace ray 2's symmetric path inside the cylinder, identifying points of refraction/reflection and using geometry to find the total internal path length.

title: Checks for total internal reflection
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may verify that ray 2 undergoes total internal reflection at point D by comparing the incident angle β with the critical angle.

title: Uses speed relation v=c/n
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly relate the speed of light in the medium to the refractive index for calculating the propagation time.

title: Sign or angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses θ=37° as the angle of incidence for Snell's law at point F, instead of its complement (53°).

title: Geometric length error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student makes an error in the geometric calculation of the internal path length (e.g., misidentifying triangles OGB or OEH).
